decomposition.title: Pac-Man: Haunting at the Library
decomposition.premise: Navigate a maze set in a haunted library, collecting books and scrolls while avoiding ghostly pursuers. Use supernatural power-ups to turn the tables and chase the ghosts away amid eerie, atmospheric visuals and sounds.

concepts.name: Pac-Man
keeps: core gameplay loop of navigating mazes

references.name: Pac-Man
keeps: core gameplay loop of navigating mazes

mechanics.description: navigate a maze to collect items and avoid enemies
eat pellets scattered throughout the maze to score points
avoid being caught by ghosts pursuing the player
eat power pellets to become able to chase and temporarily eat ghosts
emit spooky ambient sounds and eerie noises that enhance the haunted atmosphere
incorporate library-related objects such as bookshelves, ladders, and scrolls as interactive elements in the environment
create supernatural visual effects like glowing lights, floating pages, and ghostly shadows to enrich the spooky environment

spaces.description: The maze of the haunted library where the player navigates, collects items, and avoids ghosts.

core.win: collect all the books and scrolls in the haunted library maze
core.lose: the ghost catches the player navigating the library maze

mashup.why: the haunted library setting skins the primary maze navigation with thematic content and flavor mechanics, enriching the atmosphere without changing the core gam
